sections.story:
“If anything happens, I'm right behind you.
”

Jason Duval is one of the two protagonists, along with Lucia Caminos, and a playable character in Grand Theft Auto VI. Jason has a son with Lucia named Tomás.

Jason is a native of the State of Leonida, who assists drug runners and does side jobs across the state. Living in a tropical stilt house in Key Lento, he decides to make an income with Lucia and other characters transitioning to the criminal underworld, hoping it will help them escape poverty. He is an associate of Brian Heder and best friend of Cal Hampton.

He is portrayed by Dylan Rourke.

Background

“"Jason wants an easy life, but things just keep getting harder."
Jason grew up around grifters and crooks. After a stint in the Army trying to shake off his troubled teens, he found himself in the Keys doing what he knows best, working for local drug runners. It might be time to try something new.

"Another day in paradise, right?"
Meeting Lucia could be the best or worst thing to ever happen to him. Jason knows how he'd like it to turn out but right now, it's hard to tell.”

Jason Duval was born on May 1, 1996, in Ambrosia, Leonida. He was raised primarily by his mother, having first encountered his father, Jack, through a glass divider. It is implied his father became abusive to his family, and walked out of Jason's life. During his youth, Jason attended school in Ambrosia, where he played football for the Ambrosia Copperheads and earned the nickname "J-Damage".

Following his graduation, Jason enlisted in the United States Army, serving with the Marauders and eventually attaining the rank of Staff Sergeant. He got kicked out of the army because he was frustrated at his commander, found the job boring because he felt he faced too little combat, and wanted more control over his life to make his own decisions. He still misses the army life a little.

After leaving the military, he worked abroad as a private security guard for a company operating below major military contractors such as Merryweather Security. Although the position offered better pay, Jason eventually became dissatisfied with his work and resigned, explaining that he had lost interest in the profession.

Around 2024, Jason attempted to steal a red Tulip, only to be confronted by Lucia Caminos, who struck him with a baseball bat and claimed that the vehicle belonged to her mother. When police officers arrived and attempted to arrest them, Jason and Lucia worked together to overpower the officers and escaped in the stolen vehicle.

The pair subsequently began a romantic relationship, although disagreements over their involvement in criminal activities created tensions between them. Jason attempted to discourage Lucia from pursuing increasingly dangerous opportunities, while Lucia remained determined to make her own decisions. Jason also expressed reservations about starting a family, partly due to his own upbringing and concerns about becoming a father. Their disagreements eventually led to Lucia ghosting him as a form of breaking up, although Jason believed they simply had an argument and she needed space, still believing they were together.

By 2026, Jason had settled in the Leonida Keys, where he worked for local drug trafficker Brian Heder. Brian allowed Jason to live rent-free at one of his properties in Key Lento in exchange for assisting with drug deliveries, collecting debts and other criminal activities. Jason also developed a close friendship with Cal Hampton, another of Brian's associates.

During this period, Jason received a telephone call from Lucia, who had been incarcerated at Hamlet Correctional Facility. Having lost contact with her following their separation, Jason learned that Lucia had given birth to their son, Tomás, who was living with her aunt in Liberty State. Jason expressed his desire to meet their son and offered to visit Lucia in prison, with Lucia agreeing to place him on her approved visitors list.

Events of Grand Theft Auto VI

Chapter One: Just Like Paradise

Four months later, Jason continues working for Brian alongside Cal and fellow drug trafficker Donnie Carter. During a cocaine delivery in Gambit Bay, Jason and Cal assist Donnie in collecting packages dropped from his seaplane before accompanying him to a meeting with the Kingfishers. However, a dispute over the shipment results in Donnie being taken hostage by the gang. Jason infiltrates their camp, rescues Donnie and recovers Brian's money before the pair escape in Donnie's damaged aircraft. Although they successfully return to Brian's Boat Works & Marina, the incident creates further tensions between Brian and the Kingfishers.

Jason subsequently undertakes various jobs for Brian throughout the Leonida Keys, including collecting outstanding rent, recovering vehicles and assisting with local drug operations. He also helps Brian investigate the apparent betrayal of his longtime associate, Arnold, who has begun cooperating with the Kingfishers. Through Brian, Jason becomes acquainted with Kenton Rees, a former associate who now works as a treasure hunter, and begins assisting with underwater salvage operations.

Meanwhile, Lucia informs Jason that she is due to be released from prison following an early-release programme. Jason begins preparing for her return, renovating his home and arranging for her belongings to be brought to Key Lento. Upon her release, he collects Lucia from Hamlet Correctional Facility and brings her to the Leonida Keys, where she remains subject to restrictions on her movement.

Jason subsequently introduces Lucia to his associates during a gathering at The Rusty Anchor, attended by Brian, Lori Heder, Cal and Donnie. Lucia also reunites with her former prison friend, Kat, who attends alongside her wealthy boyfriend, Mattia Tauro. During the gathering, Jason and Lucia become involved in a confrontation with several naval aviators and are forced to flee following the arrival of police.

Following their reunion
sections.narrative:
Relationships
Lucia Caminos

Jason and Lucia are romantic partners in crime. Rockstar describes Lucia as the "engine" of their partnership and Jason as the "brake", with the two characters complementing one another and pushing and pulling each other throughout the story.

Because they operate in a ruthless criminal underworld, their survival relies on having each other's backs during high-stakes robberies, yet their core conflict stems from a clash of philosophies: Jason views trust as keeping things safe and controlled, while Lucia views it as equal partnership and shared ambition.

Having already broken up once, their reunion is built on a deliberate choice to give each other a second chance. Secretly parenting Tomás adds emotional weight, forcing them to trust each other not just as criminal accomplices, but as partners building a family. Jason is shown to be loyal to Lucia which is one of his core personality traits, shown by his rejection of Mandy Russell, and the game's inability to hire prostitutes.

Rather than being unconditional, their trust is treated as something that must be actively maintained. In gameplay, players manage their bond by spending time together, answering texts, going on dates, and executing heists as a team. Neglecting one another, working exclusively solo, or ignoring messages erodes their connection and alters how their story unfolds.

Cal Hampton

Jason and Cal are close friends and fellow criminal associates of Brian Heder. Their relationship is built on mutual support, casual hangouts, and everyday friction.

Raul Bautista

Raul acts as a seasoned criminal mentor, heist planner, and fixer for Jason and Lucia. He pushes them from small-time scores into higher-stakes jobs while getting pulled into their secrets. Jason is more willing to trust Raul, while Lucia often remains more cautious and skeptical of him.

Bret Vogel

Bret is Jason's old army buddy. They served together in the Army before the events of the game, remaining friends afterward.

Dolores

She is Jason's pet snake.
sections.extras:
Influence
Jason and Lucia Caminos's criminal partnership is heavily inspired by the real-life American outlaw duo Bonnie and Clyde, centered on their spree of robberies across Leonida. Notably, Grand Theft Auto VI released on November 19, 2026—the same date as Bonnie Parker and Clyde Barrow's first recorded bank robbery in 1932, further underscoring the comparison.

Trivia
• Jason's surname is likely derived from U.S. politician William Pope Duval, the first civilian governor of the Florida Territory (1822–1834). Several places in Florida bear his name—most notably Duval County, which contains the city of Jacksonville, and Duval Street in Key West, which serves as the real-life inspiration for Key Lento in the Leonida Keys.

• Jason’s first name may be inspired by the character Jason Mendoza from NBC’s The Good Place, who was famously a fan of the Jaguars from Jacksonville, Florida, in Duval County.

• According to Rockstar Games, Jason's circumstances push him into serious crimes such as drug trafficking and bank robbery, with the developers intentionally leaving it ambiguous whether he acts out of necessity or personal inclination.

sections.story:
“The only thing that matters is who you know and what you got.
”

Lucia Maria Rivera Caminos is one of the two protagonists, along with Jason Duval, and a playable character in Grand Theft Auto VI. Lucia has a son with Jason named Tomás.

Struggling to raise the money needed to raise and feed her child growing up, Lucia and Jason have turned to the criminal underworld amid financial hardship and AI taking big jobs in the 2020s. At the age of 26, Lucia's desperate financial situation motivated her to rob a payday loan store, and she was sentenced to 3 years at Hamlet Correctional Facility. Luck got Lucia out of prison earlier, but she is not as reformed as the state believes.

She is portrayed by Manni L. Perez.

Background

“"Lucia’s father taught her to fight as soon as she could walk."
Life has been coming at her swinging ever since. Fighting for her family landed her in the Leonida Penitentiary. Sheer luck got her out. Lucia’s learned her lesson — only smart moves from here.

More than anything, Lucia wants the good life her mom has dreamed of since their days in Liberty City — but instead of half-baked fantasies, Lucia is prepared to take matters into her own hands.

A life with Jason could be her way out.
Fresh out of prison and ready to change the odds in her favor, Lucia’s committed to her plan — no matter what it takes.”

Lucia Maria Rivera Caminos was born on November 20, 2000, in Liberty City, Liberty State, and is of Puerto Rican descent. She was raised by her mother, Mia Caminos, and her father, who taught her how to fight from an early age. Growing up, Lucia was determined to improve her financial circumstances and achieve the comfortable life that her mother had long dreamed of providing for their family.

During her youth, Lucia became friends with Andy Lee-Scott, who introduced her to shoplifting. She also became acquainted with Dre'Quan Priest, who gave her the nickname "Loony".

Around 2024, Lucia encountered Jason Duval while he was attempting to steal a red Greta that she had already stolen for her mother. Lucia confronted Jason and struck him with a baseball bat, but the encounter was interrupted by police officers attempting to arrest them. The pair worked together to overpower the officers and escaped in the stolen vehicle.

Lucia and Jason subsequently began a romantic relationship and became involved in criminal activities together. However, their differing attitudes towards crime gradually created tensions between them. Lucia wanted to become more involved in Jason's criminal work, while Jason attempted to discourage her from pursuing increasingly dangerous opportunities. Lucia ghosted him as a form of breaking up, but he still thought they were a couple, and viewed it as her needing alone time.

Following their separation, Lucia was shocked to discover that she was pregnant with Jason's child. She decided not to tell him about the pregnancy and subsequently gave birth to their son, Tomás. Lucia initially raised Tomás without Jason's involvement, although she struggled financially and was unable to maintain a stable income. To avoid a difficult conversation, she also lied to her mother that Jason had been unwilling to become a father and walked out of her life, despite not having informed him of the pregnancy.

Events of Grand Theft Auto VI

Chapter One: Just Like Paradise

By 2026, Lucia was living in Vice City, where she was struggling to provide for herself and Tomás. Facing mounting financial difficulties and the possibility of eviction, she attempted to rob a payday-loan business in Little Cuba, leaving Tomás temporarily in the care of a waitress at a cafe.

During the robbery, Lucia threatened the cashier and demanded money, but her attempt was interrupted by a customer who tried to restrain her. Lucia managed to escape the premises with the stolen money and fled from the responding police officers. However, she subsequently returned to the cafe to collect Tomás, unaware that the staff had already reported him as an abandoned child. Lucia was arrested upon her return, while Tomás was taken into the care of child welfare services.

Lucia was subsequently incarcerated at Leonida Penitentiary, where she spent approximately nine months. During her imprisonment, she was separated from Tomás, who eventually went to live with her aunt, Lorena Caminos, in Liberty State. The separation caused Lucia considerable distress, and she became increasingly determined to regain custody of her son and provide him with a stable upbringing.

While incarcerated, Lucia became acquainted with another inmate named Kat, a wealthy woman who was also expecting a child. Lucia developed a friendship with Kat and looked out for her during their imprisonment. Following Kat's release, Lucia remained in contact with her and learned that she had begun a relationship with wealthy businessman Mattia Tauro, who had connections throughout Vice City's criminal underworld.

During a meeting with prison counselor Stefanie Gates, Lucia discussed the circumstances surrounding her arrest and her desire to rebuild her life. Following the introduction of an early-release programme intended to reduce overcrowding, Lucia became eligible for supervised release. However, she was required to provide a suitable residential address and remain under supervision for a further nine months.

Lucia subsequently contacted Jason, revealing that she had given birth to their son and that Tomás was living with Lorena. Although surprised by the news, Jason expressed his desire to become involved in their son's life and agreed to support Lucia following her release. Lucia provided Jason's address in Key Lento as her proposed residence, allowing her release arrangements to proceed.

Upon her release from Hamlet Correctional Facility, Lucia was fitted with an ankle monitor restricting her movements to within approximately half a mile of Jason's home. Jason collected her from prison and brought her to The Rusty Anchor, wher
sections.narrative: After getting out, Lucia is determined to build a better life, and she teams up with Jason.
sections.extras:
Influence
Lucia and Jason Duval's criminal partnership across Leonida is heavily inspired by the real-life American outlaw duo Bonnie and Clyde, with Bonnie Parker having previously served as an inspiration for Catalina in the 3D Universe of the Grand Theft Auto series. Notably, Grand Theft Auto VI released on November 19, 2026—the same date as Bonnie and Clyde's first recorded bank robbery in 1932, further underscoring the comparison.

In an interview with LOVE Magazine, Rockstar Games writer Alexa D'Agostino stated that Lucia was inspired by people she knew, including her own mother. She added that her mother raised her to be "rowdy, kind, but not to take any shit," which directly shaped Lucia's personality in the game.

Trivia
• Lucia shares a few traits with Katie, one of the protagonists in the original Grand Theft Auto, who is also depicted as Latina and holds a criminal record in Vice City within the 2D Universe (albeit one shared with the game's other protagonists).

• According to her Driver's License: She is 5'3" and weighs 155lbs and lived in 133 Moorhead, Liberty City, Liberty State when she got her license.

• Lucia is the seventh playable female protagonist in the Grand Theft Auto series—following Katie, Ulrika, Mikki, Divine, Candy, Gretchen, and the GTA Online Protagonist—though she is widely regarded as the first true female lead since the previous characters were either silent or optional, while Lucia is the first major female protagonist with a fully voiced role.

• Lucia was raised in Liberty City.

• Lucia's character was partly inspired by the mother of Grand Theft Auto VI writer Alexa D'Agostino, who grew up in Newark, New Jersey.

• Lucia and Jason are both the third and fourth protagonists to have children, after Michael De Santa and Franklin Clinton.

sections.story:
Cal: “Hey, uh... I'm not made for this shit.”

Jason: “I know, man.”

Cal: “Bro, just be safe, okay? Y'know, of all the guys I've met around here, you're- you're the only one who's not a complete piece of shit.”

Cal Hampton is a character appearing as a central character and the main deuteragonist in Grand Theft Auto VI. He is portrayed by Bobby Moynihan.

Background

“'"What if everything on the internet was true?"'
Jason's friend and a fellow associate of Brian's, Cal feels safest hanging at home, snooping on Coast Guard comms with a few beers and some private browser tabs open.

'"The psychopaths are in charge. Get used to it."'
Cal is at the low tide of America and happy there. Casual paranoia loves company, but his friend Jason has bigger plans.”

Cal Hampton lives in Key Lento, Leonida, and works around Brian's Boat Works & Marina alongside Brian Heder, Donnie Carter, and his close friend Jason Duval. While Jason pursues bigger, riskier criminal ambitions, Cal prefers keeping a low profile around the keys.

Appearance

Cal is a stocky man with a scruffy beard and casual coastal attire suited to life around Key Lento and the boatyard, often seen around Brian's Boat Works & Marina and The Rusty Anchor.

Personality

Laid-back, anxious, and prone to conspiracy theories and casual paranoia, Cal is much more comfortable drinking beers, browsing the internet, and listening in on Coast Guard radio traffic than getting pulled into heavy violence or high-stakes criminal jobs. Despite his jittery nature, he is loyal to Jason and candid about feeling out of his depth when things turn dangerous.

Events of Grand Theft Auto VI

In 2026, Cal operates out of Key Lento as a boatyard associate of Brian Heder and a close friend of Jason Duval. When jobs escalate into outright gunfights and high-stakes trouble—such as during "Gone Fishing"—Cal realizes he isn't cut out for the life and urges Jason to stay safe.
sections.extras:
Trivia
• Cal's very paranoid personality and his belief in conspiracies are an easy reminder of Ron Jakowski from Grand Theft Auto V.

sections.story:
“The club money pay for the studio, and the drug money pay for it all.”

Boobie Ike is a major supporting character appearing in Grand Theft Auto VI. A longtime Vice City street legend turned prominent businessman, he owns the Jack of Hearts strip club in Crosstown, real estate properties across the city, and a recording studio, partnering with Dre'Quan Priest on the record label Only Raw Records. He is voiced by Mike Forbs.

Background

“'"It's all about heart – the Jack of Hearts."'
Boobie is a local Vice City legend – and acts like it. One of the few to transform his time in the streets into a legitimate empire spanning real estate, a strip club, and a recording studio – Boobie's all smiles until it's time to talk business.

'"Top quality cuts."'
Boobie might seem like he's just out for himself, but it's his partnership with the young aspiring music mogul Dre'Quan for Only Raw Records that he's most invested in – now they just need a hit.”

Having risen from Vice City's street underworld, Boobie Ike built a legitimate business empire spanning local real estate, the Jack of Hearts strip club in Crosstown, and a recording studio. Seeking to break into the music industry, he partnered with young producer and manager Dre'Quan Priest to fund Only Raw Records, signing local hip-hop duo Real Dimez (Bae-Luxe and Roxy) in search of a commercial hit.

Appearance

Boobie is a heavy-set, middle-aged Black man with a shaved head, a full beard, and numerous tattoos across his arms and torso. He favors flashy, high-roller attire—including open patterned button-up shirts, designer sunglasses, heavy gold chains, rings, and luxury watches—reflecting his status as a Vice City nightlife mogul.

Personality

Charismatic, larger-than-life, and street-smart, Boobie carries himself like a seasoned Vice City kingpin who enjoys the nightlife and status his empire affords. While generous and welcoming toward trusted associates—such as letting Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos stay in one of his apartments—he turns strictly business-minded when money, territory, or his investments in Only Raw Records are on the line.

Events of Grand Theft Auto VI

In 2026, at the start of Chapter 3 ("Welcome to Vice City"), Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos arrive in Vice City needing a place to lie low and meet Jason's longtime friend Dre'Quan Priest at the Jack of Hearts in Crosstown. Dre'Quan brings them upstairs to meet Boobie, who welcomes them and lets them stay rent-free in one of his nearby apartments.

As Chapter 3 progresses, Boobie works closely with Dre'Quan to bankroll and push Only Raw Records and Real Dimez, using club revenue and street connections to keep the label afloat while Jason and Lucia take on jobs tied to Boobie and Dre'Quan's operations across Vice City.

“Dancers are like my A&Rs. If the record's a hit, DJs gonna be spinnin' it.”

Dre'Quan Priest is one of the two tritagonists in Grand Theft Auto VI. He is a long time friend of Jason Duval.

He is voiced by Naiqui Macabroad.

Background

“"Only Raw... Records"
Dre'Quan was always more of a hustler than a gangster. Even when he was dealing on the streets to make ends meet, breaking into music was the goal.

"You're with the label now."
Now that he's signed the Real Dimez, Dre'Quan's days of booking acts into Boobie's strip club might be numbered as he sets his sights on the Vice City scene.”

“All my dimes in this club. Meet my twin, make it a dub.”

Real Dimez is a rap duo appearing in Grand Theft Auto VI.

Background

“"Viral videos. Viral hooks."
Bae-Luxe and Roxy aka Real Dimez have been friends since high school — girls with the savvy to turn their time shaking down local dealers into cold, hard cash via spicy rap tracks and a relentless social media presence.

"One hit away from fame."
An early hit single with local rapper DWNPLY took Real Dimez to new heights. Now, after five years and a whole lot of trouble, they’re signed to Only Raw Records, hoping lightning can strike twice.”
sections.extras:
Influence
Real Dimez draws strong parallels with former Miami hip-hop duo City Girls, consisting of Yung Miami and JT. Both groups began their careers by leveraging social media to promote their music and gained mainstream popularity through high-profile collaborations: Real Dimez with fellow Vice City rapper DWNPLY on an unspecified hit single, and City Girls with Canadian rapper Drake on his 2018 hit single "In My Feelings". Notably, the City Girls' 2019 single "Act Up" is featured on the iFruit Radio station in Grand Theft Auto V and Online.

sections.story:
“Life is full of surprises, my friend. I think we'd all be wise to remember that.”

Raul Bautista is one of the two tritagonists in Grand Theft Auto VI.

A seasoned bank robber, Raul acts as a mentor figure who helps push Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos from smaller jobs into larger, coordinated criminal operations. Confident, charming, cunning, and reckless, he constantly chases big scores and raises the stakes with each job.

He is portrayed by Manny Perez.

Background

“"Experience counts."
Confidence, charm, and cunning — Raul’s a seasoned bank robber always on the hunt for talent ready to take the risks that bring the biggest rewards.

"A professional adapts."
Raul's recklessness raises the stakes with every score. Sooner or later, his crew will have to double down or pull their chips from the table.”

Raul Bautista serves as an older mentor to Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, providing the criminal experience they lack when they arrive in Vice City. He introduces them to the large-scale heists and criminal operations that become part of their story. Rockstar Games also intended Raul to embody Vice City and its local criminal culture.

Events of Grand Theft Auto VI

Following his betrayal by his partner Valentina, Raul is captured and severely tortured by corrupt Vice City Police Department Captain Méndez in an effort to force him to reveal the location of the stolen hard drive—though Raul refuses to talk. After receiving a note at the Y Hotel directing them to Ocean Beach Marina, Jason and Lucia board Raul's ransacked houseboat during the Chapter 4 mission "Sunset" and find him critically injured in a small lower-deck bathroom.

With his final words, Raul warns Jason and Lucia that Valentina sold him out to Méndez and the police, and reveals that Andrea still has the drive. Knowing he cannot survive his injuries and hearing law enforcement closing in on the marina, Raul begs Jason to end his suffering before they arrive; Jason can shoot him to put him out of his misery, though Lucia will shoot him herself if Jason hesitates or refuses, leaving his death unavoidable before the pair fight their way out of the marina.

“You gotta know when to get off, Jason. You hear me?”

Brian Heder is a character appearing as a central character and deuteragonist to Jason Duval in Grand Theft Auto VI.

He is a veteran drug smuggler and landlord in the Leonida Keys who serves as Jason's employer and mentor. He built his criminal empire during the golden age of Keys smuggling and now runs operations through his boatyard alongside his third wife, Lori.

He is voiced by Stephen Root.

Background

“"Nothing better than a Mudslide at sunset."
Brian's a classic drug runner from the golden age of smuggling in the Keys. Still moving product through his boat yard with his third wife, Lori, Brian's been around long enough to let others do his dirty work.

"Looks like a Leonida beach bum — moves like a great white shark."
Brian’s letting Jason live rent-free at one of his properties — so long as he helps with local shakedowns, and stops by for Lori’s sangria once in a while.”

Events of Grand Theft Auto VI

To be written.
